title: Foreign gadget bans: all the news about the FCC’s clampdown on Chinese tech
summary: What do drones, routers, and Roombas have in common? The US government wants to keep Chinese ones from entering the country. They’re the first consumer gadgets that are facing de facto import bans because of the US government’s xenophobic stance — and they might not be the last.
